content:
Genera primero una imagen base con GPT Image 2 (p. ej., un partido de fútbol en 1890) especificando detalles históricos concretos (uniformes de lana, balón de cuero antiguo, campo irregular, ambiente victoriano) para anclar la escena antes de animarla.  
Usa Seedance 2.0 para transformar la escena de forma continua entre épocas (1890 → 1930 → 1970 → 2000 → 2026) y lograr transiciones sin cortes bruscos en un solo plano.

Use Seedance 2.0 to transform the scene continuously between eras (1890 → 1930 → 1970 → 2000 → 2026) and achieve seamless transitions in a single shot.

• Old leather balls
• Uneven fields
• Victorian atmosphere

[Thread 2] Then, I used Seedance 2.0 to transform the scene continuously:
1890 → 1930 → 1970 → 2000 → 2026

From small wooden stands to true cathedrals of sport with LED lighting, giant screens, and thousands of fans. https://t.co/TGDqrQGKc0

19th-century players gradually transform into modern athletes with state-of-the-art equipment and elite physical training. https://t.co/1ux2WNMpEv

✓ Sports history
